test_dataframe_interpolate_basic: test the DataFrame.interpolate() method to linearly fill NaN values between existing data points
test_series_interpolate_complex: test the Series.interpolate() method to interpolate complex number values with NaN gaps
test_interpolate_datetime_values: test the interpolate() method on datetime, timedelta, and timezone-aware datetime series
test_interpolate_inplace: test the interpolate() method with inplace=True to modify the object in-place without copying
test_interpolate_scipy_methods: test the interpolate() method with scipy methods including polynomial, cubic, quadratic, nearest, and pchip
test_interpolate_axis_rowwise: test the interpolate() method with axis=1 for rowwise interpolation across columns
test_interpolate_non_numeric_raises: test that interpolate() raises TypeError when called on DataFrames with object dtype columns
test_interpolate_empty_dataframe: test the interpolate() method on an empty DataFrame returns a non-empty copy
test_interpolate_nullable_ea_dtypes: test the interpolate() method with nullable integer and float extension array dtypes with limit parameter
test_interpolate_time_method: test the interpolate() method with method='time' for time-weighted interpolation on datetime-indexed data
